input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only cap in the Agreement (p0077, inside the indemnity section) is one-sided: it limits TrueLink's liability to 12 months' hosting and support compensation, while Client's liability — including the very broad indemnity at Sections 12a(i)–(iv) — is entirely uncapped. That is expressly walk-away territory under LOL-CAP ("Customer's liability uncapped while Vendor's is capped") and fails the fallback, which requires a mutual cap. There is also no exclusion of indirect/consequential damages anywhere in the document and no carve-out set beyond TrueLink's own gross negligence/wilful misconduct. Our redline makes the cap mutual and agreement-wide at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, and adds the standard Excluded Claims carve-out (confidentiality/data security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) plus confirmation that Client's payment obligations are not limited by the cap. Note the fee basis rests on Exhibits A and B, which are still blank; the 12-month compensation measure remains meaningful once those charges are populated.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual and agreement-wide, set it at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, and add standard uncapped carve-outs.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The current cap protects only TrueLink and only for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11, leaving Client's liability entirely uncapped; our position is a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees and USD 1,000,000. We have kept indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and confirmed Client's payment obligations are not limited by it.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE BY CLIENT FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE 12 MONTH PERIOD IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY AMOUNTS DUE UNDER SECTION 5 SHALL NOT BE SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
